# S4.13 — hosted/subagent durability: lineage, provider envs, wakeups, intra-run branches

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s4.12` (PR #75) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

Lands the hosted/subagent durability slices across five surfaces:
derived-index reads + the 10⁵-event latency criterion
(`R-2.2.1¹`), intra-run branches with promote/discard and the
`SpeculationPolicy` gate (`R-2.2.4` C2), goal continuation +
inbox runs + the `schedule`/`external`/`peer_message` wakeup
family (`R-2.2.3` C1 S4), the `remote_ephemeral`/
`remote_persistent`/`provider_hosted` classes with provider
adapters, suspend/resume, share leases and `detach_to_child`
(`R-2.2.5¹`), and the hosted lift table — status mapping,
`session.resumed`, unknown-kind preservation (`R-2.2.2²`).

Requirement ids: `R-2.2.1¹`, `R-2.2.5¹`, `R-2.2.2²`,
`R-2.2.3 (C1 S4)`, `R-2.2.4 (C2)`.
Gates: `AC-R-2.2.1-{16}`, `AC-R-2.2.2-{9}`, `AC-R-2.2.3-{10,13,15}`,
`AC-R-2.2.4-{10}`, `AC-R-2.2.5-{13}`, `removability(0…3)` — all
deterministic, all green.

## What changed

- **`crates/hh-ledger`** —
  - `store.rs`: derived indexes (`by_event_id`, `by_class`,
    `ir_index`) maintained incrementally inside the batch commit;
    filtered `read` intersects postings then re-checks the full
    predicate — byte-identical to the linear scan, rebuild posts
    identically (ADR-0305 D1; OQ-388 measured leg).
  - `branch_ops.rs` (new): `open_branch`/`promote_branch`/
    `discard_branch` — kernel-owned `lifecycle.branch.*` rows,
    coherent fork points, `defer_irreversible` floor +
    `permissions[]` containment (`AuthorityWidening` at fork),
    `max_concurrent_branches`, explicit `releases` map
    (`DeferredReleaseMissing`), `committed{release:
    branch_promotion}` with fresh attempts/fencing, per-phase
    effect termination on discard, logical-HEAD rewind,
    `budget_slice_id` spend posting, root-first
    `abandoned{budget_exhausted}`.
  - `goal.rs` (new): `open_inbox` (`run_kind = inbox`,
    `goal_ref` required, agent-only manifest cells cleared),
    `continue_goal` (`continued_from{run_id, at_seq, head_hash}`,
    `activation_no`, restart-stable `AlreadyContinued`), goal-
    scoped subscriptions owned `goal:<ref>` on the inbox run.
  - `wakeup.rs`: `schedule` (interval/cron grammar validated at
    subscribe), `external` (admissible on every run kind;
    `source_ref`/`filter`), `peer_message`; unattended triggers
    on `attendance = interactive` require
    `policy.attendance_required`; durable `occurred` before fire;
    duplicate `occurrence_key` → audited `skipped` (idempotent).
  - `manifest.rs`: `goal_ref` + inbox validation.
  - `classes.rs`: `lifecycle.branch.*`, `lifecycle.session.resumed`
    registrations; `hosted_lowering` pair; branch/budget audit
    fields.
  - `export.rs`: `export_audit_view_with_lineage` — `lineage[]`
    root-first on the audit export.
  - `errors.rs`: typed branch/goal/wakeup error set.
- **`crates/hh-env`** — `provider.rs` (new `ProviderAdapter`:
  provision/suspend/resume/teardown/meters + `ProviderMeter`
  declared-vs-unreported partitioning); `driver.rs` (adapter
  gate for the three provider classes; `suspend`/`resume` on the
  declared `SuspendKind` with `suspended_ms` accrual; detach —
  ephemeral tears down, persistent/provider-hosted survive;
  `detach_to_child`; `share` mode with resource-key leases;
  parent-teardown cascade); `handle.rs` (`Suspended`/`Detached`/
  `Unreachable`, `HostedBinding` participant-origin rows, meters).
- **`crates/hh-hosting`** — `hosted_status.rs` (new): the
  five-state hosted map onto native effect classes;
  `cancelled`→`unknown{cancelled}`; undeclared spellings →
  `unknown{executor_error}` + `status_raw` (never `read_only`,
  never a fabricated terminal — AC-R-2.2.2-9). `proj.rs`:
  `session.resumed` → `lifecycle.session.resumed` verbatim
  (ADR-0305 D2); `stop_reason_raw` lift; unknown kinds →
  `lifecycle.hosted.native_record`.
- **`crates/hh-mcp`** — target-side idempotency-key forwarding
  verified: `params.target` = the kernel's `idempotency_key`
  verbatim on every `tools/call` (§5d.4; R-2.2.2²).
- **`crates/hh-embed` + schema** — `durability_ops.rs` (new):
  `branch.open`/`promote`/`discard`, `continue_goal`,
  `open_inbox`, `subscribe`, `record_occurrence`,
  `env.suspend`/`env.resume`; `env.derive` admits `share` +
  `detach_to_child`; boundary `discard` records the honest
  `compensation_failed{boundary: no_dispatch}` (ADR-0305 D3). Op
  registry entries (experimental) + param shapes; regenerated
  `hh-embed-1.schema.json` + generated client.
- **`crates/hh-fleet`/`hh-subagent`** — `Trigger::External` gains
  `source_ref`/`filter`; fleet admissibility test updated
  (`external` left the fleet-only boundary, `manual` stays
  fleet-bound, `environment_ready` keeps its refusal — ADR-0305
  D4). `hh-subagent/src/ownership.rs` also carries a mechanical
  `never_loop` lint fix (the cross-run holder scan's body always
  returned on the first element; now `if let Some` over the
  first holder — behaviour identical).

## Reviewer notes

- `session.resumed` lifts to `lifecycle.session.resumed`, not
  `lifecycle.run.resumed` — a participant-origin row asserting a
  kernel lifecycle transition would be authority widening (CC2;
  ADR-0305 D2). Consumers folding on `run.resumed` see only
  kernel-performed resumes.
- The `read(filter)` index is a posting accelerator only —
  `ac_r_2_2_1_16_class_filtered_read_matches_linear_semantics`
  proves result-identity vs the linear scan.
- Branch `discard` at the embed boundary is honestly weaker than
  the orchestrator path (`compensation_failed{boundary:
  no_dispatch}` on the durable row — ADR-0305 D3).
- The 10⁵-event latency fixture is `#[ignore]`d by default
  (build ≈ 12 s); run it with
  `cargo test -p hh-ledger --test s4_13 latency_1e5 -- --ignored`.
- Merge is operator-controlled (`mergePolicy: OPERATOR`).
